description: Per-file count of parseFloat( calls in server/ and shared/ source (tests excluded). parseFloat turns numeric(...) money strings into binary floats, and sums of those drift by fractions of a cent; new code uses server/lib/money.ts instead. tests/float-money-ratchet.test.ts fails when a file's count rises or a new file starts using parseFloat, and when a count falls without this baseline being lowered to match, so the total can only go down.
